q: Two Bernoulli shifts B(p₁,...,pₖ) and B(q₁,...,qₘ) are isomorphic as MPTs iff:
opts: H(p₁,...,pₖ) = H(q₁,...,qₘ) (same KS entropy) — by Ornstein's theorem
They have the same number of symbols k=m
exp: Ornstein (1970): entropy is the complete invariant for Bernoulli shifts. B(1/2,1/2) ≅ B(1/3,1/3,1/3) since both have entropy log 2. This is remarkable: systems defined on completely different state spaces are isomorphic based only on their entropy.
